description: This file implements event polling mechanisms for Linux epoll and BSD kqueue, including loop management, poll creation, timer, and async event handling.

methods.name: us_loop_free
methods.description: Frees the event loop, internal data, and closes the loop's file descriptor.

methods.name: us_create_poll
methods.description: Creates a new poll object associated with the event loop.

methods.name: us_poll_free
methods.description: Frees a poll object and decrements the poll count.

methods.name: us_poll_ext
methods.description: Returns extension data pointer for a poll.

methods.name: us_poll_init
methods.description: Initializes a poll with a socket descriptor and poll type.

methods.name: us_poll_events
methods.description: Returns the events a poll is interested in.

methods.name: us_poll_fd
methods.description: Returns the socket descriptor associated with a poll.

methods.name: us_internal_poll_type
methods.description: Returns the poll type bits.

methods.name: us_internal_poll_set_type
methods.description: Sets the poll type bits.

methods.name: us_timer_ext
methods.description: Returns extension data for a timer.

methods.name: us_timer_loop
methods.description: Returns the event loop associated with a timer.

methods.name: us_create_loop
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new event loop with optional callbacks.

methods.name: us_loop_run
methods.description: Runs the event loop, processing ready polls and dispatching events.

methods.name: us_internal_loop_update_pending_ready_polls
methods.description: Updates the list of pending ready polls after changes.

methods.name: us_poll_resize
methods.description: Resizes a poll object, updating underlying epoll/kqueue registration.

methods.name: us_poll_start
methods.description: Starts polling a socket for specified events.

methods.name: us_poll_change
methods.description: Modifies the events a poll is interested in.

methods.name: us_poll_stop
methods.description: Stops polling a socket.

methods.name: us_internal_accept_poll_event
methods.description: Reads and returns an event from the poll, specific to epoll.

methods.name: us_create_timer
methods.description: Creates a timer poll, using timerfd on epoll or kevent on kqueue.

methods.name: us_timer_close
methods.description: Closes and cleans up a timer.

methods.name: us_timer_set
methods.description: Sets a callback and timing for a timer.

methods.name: us_internal_create_async
methods.description: Creates an asynchronous wakeup event, using eventfd or kevent.

methods.name: us_internal_async_close
methods.description: Closes an async event.

methods.name: us_internal_async_set
methods.description: Sets a callback for an async event.

methods.name: us_internal_async_wakeup
methods.description: Triggers the async event to wake up the loop.
